remarks:
One of a Kind Immaculate Estate with Views in Boston, NY
We are pleased to present a truly remarkable one-of-a-kind private farmhouse estate in Boston, NY.  Upon approach, this country estate has all of the appointments of a century farmhouse with the feel of a English garden, or botanical sanctuary with privacy and manicured landscaping created with the loving care of a true gardeners vison for country living at its finest. This property presents as an immaculate park like setting with spectacular views and privacy just minutes from the south towns and bustle of the greater Buffalo area.
There are 5,000 blueberry bushes and a vineyard is onsite always having been manicured with a NO SPRAY maintenance philosophy. A large pond is a feature on the estate where a reflection bench is located to enjoy the water, and a second bench is located under the shade of a goliath red oak tree to just rest in a quiet place.  
The home is unique, open, warm, charming, relaxing and has an interior layout with multiple rooms befitting a historic estate property.
A grand great room with vaulted ceiling is the center living space. There is a tearoom with wrapped windows just of the kitchen, and a second reading room just off of the dining room.  A large main floor bedroom overlooks the backyard garden and water feature and would be an extension of the lower-level reading room making this its own living space.  The dining room has multiple windows and a coffered ceiling. The primary bedroom is on the second floor and has its own fireplace and large ensuite bathroom that connects to one of the reading rooms overlooking the great room. Enjoying the English style garden space is a place new owners will enjoy as a retreat space and would be the place to rest and relax.  A large paver stone patio and walkway leads to a hedged grass court is also part of the garden, elevated and overlooking fruit trees and vineyard.
The property is so well manicured, it is easily suitable for weddings or an air bnb destination
With so much to see and enjoy having custom living space, beautiful views and tranquility the fortunate new homeowner with enjoy a one of a kind home!
